actions.action: Higher offline card limit during the migration

message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, 12:00 CT, Cobalt moves to a new core banking system. For those 36 hours the app is read-only: you can see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards are paused. Your card keeps working offline: we raised the limit to $250 per payment for that weekend. If something goes wrong the switch can take some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. Starting today you can turn on an alert for every card payment and order a free new card in the app.
why:
Tell customers early and plainly what the migration weekend means.
The $250 offline limit covers most weekend card spending while transfers are paused.
Payment alerts and a free card guard against the phishing wave seen after other migrations.

message: Thank you for your patience during our system move. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge, we credit up to $100 to your account right away while we investigate. Open the transaction in the app and tap Dispute.
why:
Card disputes are the top complaint driver.
Instant credit after the migration week targets App Store and CFPB complaints.
Cheap, leaving room in the budget for a response to surprises.
